examples.text_en: We did not mean to peep at her book.
examples.text_zh: 我们并不是有意偷看她的书。

examples.text_en: The children peeped through the door at the game.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们透过门偷看那场游戏。

examples.text_en: Her work was quite peerless in this whole city.
examples.text_zh: 她的作品在这整座城市里都无与伦比。

examples.text_en: They show a peerless kind of hard work here.
examples.text_zh: 他们在这里展现出一种无与伦比的刻苦。

examples.text_en: The old man had a peery look today.
examples.text_zh: 那位老人今天露出一副怀疑的神色。

examples.text_en: The peery woman can ask about every small thing.
examples.text_zh: 那个多疑的女人对每一件小事都要问个明白。

examples.text_en: The bad music will peeve my father today.
examples.text_zh: 这糟糕的音乐今天会惹我父亲生气。

examples.text_en: Little things peeve him more than they should.
examples.text_zh: 小事让他恼火得有些过分。

examples.text_en: He was peevish after a long hard day.
examples.text_zh: 漫长而辛苦的一天之后，他变得暴躁易怒。

examples.text_en: The peevish child would not eat any food.
examples.text_zh: 那个闹脾气的孩子什么也不肯吃。

examples.text_en: He used a pejorative word about my work.
examples.text_zh: 他用一个贬损的词来评论我的工作。

examples.text_en: That pejorative name was not true at all.
examples.text_zh: 那个贬损的称呼完全不真实。

examples.text_en: They care only about pelf and their own power.
examples.text_zh: 他们只在乎不义之财和自己的权势。

examples.text_en: The man found his pelf through a bad business.
examples.text_zh: 那人靠一桩不正当的生意发了一笔不义之财。

examples.text_en: The books were left all pell-mell on the table.
examples.text_zh: 书本乱七八糟地堆在桌上。

examples.text_en: They ran pell-mell through the whole old town.
examples.text_zh: 他们乱哄哄地跑过整座老城。

examples.text_en: The water here was clear and quite pellucid.
examples.text_zh: 这里的水清澈，十分明净。

examples.text_en: Her pellucid words were a great help to us.
examples.text_zh: 她明白晓畅的讲解对我们帮助很大。

examples.text_en: Children pelt the old door with small balls.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们用小圆球不停地砸那扇旧门。

examples.text_en: She had a fine pelt for the trade.
examples.text_zh: 她有一张上好的毛皮用来交易。

examples.text_en: The government will add a penal tax on that trade.
examples.text_zh: 政府将对那项贸易加征一种惩罚性的税。

examples.text_en: They face a penal law from the old system.
examples.text_zh: 他们面临旧体制下的一条刑法。

examples.text_en: The rules will penalize those who always come late.
examples.text_zh: 规定将处罚那些总是迟到的人。

examples.text_en: They should not penalize the whole group for this.
examples.text_zh: 他们不该因为这件事处罚整个小组。

examples.text_en: He did penance for the wrong things he had done.
examples.text_zh: 他为自己做过的错事进行赎罪苦修。

examples.text_en: She saw her long work as a form of penance.
examples.text_zh: 她把自己长期的工作看作一种赎罪。

examples.text_en: He has a real penchant for old music and art.
examples.text_zh: 他对古老的音乐和艺术有真正的爱好。

examples.text_en: Her penchant for good food is well known.
examples.text_zh: 她对美食的嗜好是出了名的。

examples.text_en: A pendent light was above the long table.
examples.text_zh: 一盏下垂的灯悬在长桌上方。

examples.text_en: The whole question is still pendent before the court.
examples.text_zh: 这个问题在法庭上仍悬而未决。

examples.text_en: The final decision is still pending at this time.
examples.text_zh: 最终决定此时仍未作出。

examples.text_en: We must wait because the matter is pending.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须等待，因为这件事仍待决。

examples.text_en: A pendulum can move from side to side.
examples.text_zh: 钟摆可以从一边摆到另一边。

examples.text_en: The market can move like a pendulum this year.
examples.text_zh: 市场今年可能像钟摆一样摇摆不定。

examples.text_en: She had a penetrating look that saw every truth.
examples.text_zh: 她目光敏锐，能看穿每一个真相。

examples.text_en: His penetrating words cut through the whole problem.
examples.text_zh: 他一针见血的话剖析了整个问题。

examples.text_en: The penetration of the light was deep and clear.
examples.text_zh: 光线的穿透深沉而清晰。

examples.text_en: Her penetration into the question was a real help.
examples.text_zh: 她对这一问题的洞察力给了我很大帮助。

examples.text_en: The penicillin can help him with a serious health problem.
examples.text_zh: 青霉素能帮他解决严重的健康问题。

examples.text_en: This penicillin was a great help to the small boy.
examples.text_zh: 这种青霉素对那个小男孩帮助很大。

examples.text_en: They want to be penitent for the bad act.
examples.text_zh: 他们想为那件坏事表示悔悟。

examples.text_en: Her penitent words show she was really sorry.
examples.text_zh: 她悔悟的话语表明她真的感到抱歉。

examples.text_en: A red pennant was on the top of the building.
examples.text_zh: 楼顶挂着一面红色的三角旗。

examples.text_en: The team won a pennant for the whole school.
examples.text_zh: 这支队伍为全校赢得了一面锦旗。

examples.text_en: She was pensive after reading the long story.
examples.text_zh: 读完那个长长的故事后，她陷入沉思。

examples.text_en: His pensive face can show a mind full of thought.
examples.text_zh: 他沉思的神情透出满脑子的思绪。

examples.text_en: This is the penultimate page of the whole book.
examples.text_zh: 这是整本书的倒数第二页。

examples.text_en: He was second in the penultimate race of the day.
examples.text_zh: 他在当天倒数第二场比赛中获得第二。

examples.text_en: The penumbra of the light was not at all clear.
examples.text_zh: 那光的半影完全看不清楚。

examples.text_en: They lived in the penumbra of the great city.
examples.text_zh: 他们生活在这座大城市的边缘。

examples.text_en: The old man lived in penury all his life.
examples.text_zh: 那位老人一生都生活在贫困之中。

examples.text_en: A family can fall into penury after a long war.
examples.text_zh: 一个家庭在长期战争后可能陷入贫困。

examples.text_en: This food is good for the peptic system.
examples.text_zh: 这种食物对消化系统有好处。

examples.text_en: A peptic problem can make a man feel bad.
examples.text_zh: 胃部的毛病会让人感到难受。

examples.text_en: The cost per capita was quite low this year.
examples.text_zh: 今年人均成本相当低。

examples.text_en: They use less water per capita than we do.
examples.text_zh: 他们的人均用水量比我们少。

examples.text_en: We like to perambulate the old town at night.
examples.text_zh: 我们喜欢夜里在老城区漫步。

examples.text_en: The old man can perambulate the park every morning.
examples.text_zh: 那位老人每天早晨都能在公园里散步。

examples.text_en: There was a perceptible change in the whole room.
examples.text_zh: 整个房间里有了可以察觉的变化。

examples.text_en: Her pain was almost perceptible to the group.
examples.text_zh: 她的疼痛几乎能被这一组人察觉到。

examples.text_en: His perception of the whole thing was very clear.
examples.text_zh: 他对整件事的领悟非常清楚。

examples.text_en: This film can change my perception of the real world.
examples.text_zh: 这部电影能改变我对现实世界的看法。

examples.text_en: She is a perceptive person with a good mind.
examples.text_zh: 她是个有洞察力、头脑很好的人。

examples.text_en: His perceptive answer can help the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 他有见地的回答能帮助整个小组。

examples.text_en: The study was about perceptual experience in young children.
examples.text_zh: 这项研究关注幼儿的知觉经验。

examples.text_en: A perceptual change can be hard to see.
examples.text_zh: 知觉上的变化可能很难看出来。

examples.text_en: The water will percolate through the hard ground.
examples.text_zh: 水会渗透过硬实的地面。

examples.text_en: Let the hot water percolate for a few minutes.
examples.text_zh: 让热水滤上几分钟。

examples.text_en: The music had a strong percussion part for us.
examples.text_zh: 这首音乐为我们设了强烈的打击乐部分。

examples.text_en: They play percussion in the school music group.
examples.text_zh: 他们在学校乐队里演奏打击乐。

examples.text_en: The percussionist was the best in the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 这位打击乐手是整个乐团里最出色的。

examples.text_en: A good percussionist can hold the whole team together.
examples.text_zh: 一位优秀的打击乐手能让整个乐队保持整齐。

examples.text_en: Their long peregrination was across this whole land.
examples.text_zh: 他们漫长的徒步旅程遍及这整片土地。

examples.text_en: We read a book about his peregrination last year.
examples.text_zh: 我们去年读了一本关于他远行的书。

examples.text_en: His peremptory answer left us with no choice.
examples.text_zh: 他断然的回答让我们别无选择。

examples.text_en: The peremptory order can come from the top office.
examples.text_zh: 这道强制的命令可能来自最高部门。

examples.text_en: This is a perennial problem for the whole city.
examples.text_zh: 这是整座城市长期存在的问题。

examples.text_en: They have a perennial need for more water here.
examples.text_zh: 他们这里常年需要更多的水。

examples.text_en: The small town is perennially short of good water.
examples.text_zh: 这个小镇长期缺乏干净的水。

examples.text_en: Their story is perennially read in this old school.
examples.text_zh: 他们的故事在这所老学校里一直被反复传诵。

examples.text_en: Her perfervid love for the work was clear to all.
examples.text_zh: 她对这项工作的满腔热情大家都看得出来。

examples.text_en: They give a perfervid talk about the great plan.
examples.text_zh: 他们就这项伟大计划发表了热情洋溢的讲话。

examples.text_en: The perfidious man left his friends in hard times.
examples.text_zh: 那个背信弃义的男人在困难时期抛下了朋友。

examples.text_en: It was a perfidious act against the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 那是对整个小组的背信行为。

examples.text_en: His perfidy was a deep pain to the family.
examples.text_zh: 他的背信弃义给家人带来深深的痛苦。

examples.text_en: They never forget the perfidy of that bad year.
examples.text_zh: 他们永远不会忘记那一年遭到的背信弃义。

examples.text_en: Please do not perforate the paper in this book.
examples.text_zh: 请不要在这本书的纸上打孔。

examples.text_en: They perforate the wall to let in light.
examples.text_zh: 他们在墙上打孔，让光线透进来。

examples.text_en: He read the report perfunctorily and left the room.
examples.text_zh: 他敷衍地看了一遍报告就离开了房间。

examples.text_en: We answer the questions perfunctorily when it is late.
examples.text_zh: 时间晚了，我们回答这些问题就很敷衍。

examples.text_en: It was a perfunctory answer with no real thought.
examples.text_zh: 那是个毫无真心的敷衍回答。

examples.text_en: He had a perfunctory look at the work.
examples.text_zh: 他随随便便地看了一眼那项工作。

examples.text_en: At its perigee a star can come near the earth.
examples.text_zh: 在近地点时，一颗星会靠近地球。

examples.text_en: The perigee point was low and close last night.
examples.text_zh: 近地点昨晚又低又近。

examples.text_en: The whole city was in great peril that day.
examples.text_zh: 那天整座城市都处在极大的危险中。

examples.text_en: They put their life in peril to help us.
examples.text_zh: 他们冒着生命危险来帮助我们。

examples.text_en: The long way home was dark and quite perilous.
examples.text_zh: 回家的漫漫长路又黑又危险。

examples.text_en: They had a perilous time on the high sea.
examples.text_zh: 他们在海上经历过一段危险的时光。

examples.text_en: We walk the whole perimeter of the old field.
examples.text_zh: 我们绕着那块旧田走了一整圈。

examples.text_en: The perimeter of this room is not very large.
examples.text_zh: 这个房间的周长不算很大。

examples.text_en: They read a periodical about art every month.
examples.text_zh: 他们每月读一本关于艺术的期刊。

examples.text_en: This periodical can come out every month.
examples.text_zh: 这份期刊每月出一期。

examples.text_en: They check the old system periodically for any problem.
examples.text_zh: 他们定期检查这个旧系统，看有没有问题。

examples.text_en: We must change the water periodically in this place.
examples.text_zh: 在这个地方，我们必须定期换水。

examples.text_en: She had a peripatetic life and would move a lot.
examples.text_zh: 她过着漂泊的生活，经常搬家。

examples.text_en: Their peripatetic way of life was far from home.
examples.text_zh: 他们四处漫游的生活方式远离家乡。

examples.text_en: The question was peripheral to the main problem.
examples.text_zh: 这个问题与主要问题无关紧要。

examples.text_en: She saw a small light in her peripheral view.
examples.text_zh: 她的余光瞥见了一点微光。

examples.text_en: They live on the periphery of the great city.
examples.text_zh: 他们住在这座大城市的边缘。

examples.text_en: The new road can run along the periphery of town.
examples.text_zh: 这条新路沿着城镇的外围延伸。

examples.text_en: He used a periphrastic way to say a simple thing.
examples.text_zh: 他用迂回的说法来表达一件简单的事。

examples.text_en: Her periphrastic answer was long and hard to follow.
examples.text_zh: 她冗长的回答又长又难懂。

examples.text_en: The man used a periscope to see the far land.
examples.text_zh: 那人用潜望镜眺望远方的陆地。

examples.text_en: A periscope can let you see above the water.
examples.text_zh: 潜望镜能让你看到水面之上的景象。

examples.text_en: The pain was perishing on that long night.
examples.text_zh: 那个漫长的夜晚，疼痛令人难以忍受。

examples.text_en: It was a perishing day for the whole team.
examples.text_zh: 对整支队伍来说，那是极其糟糕的一天。

examples.text_en: He would perjure himself to save his own name.
examples.text_zh: 他为了保住自己的名声会去作伪证。

examples.text_en: Do not perjure yourself in front of the court.
examples.text_zh: 不要在法庭上作伪证。

examples.text_en: The court found him in perjury that day.
examples.text_zh: 那天法庭认定他作了伪证。

examples.text_en: We saw no perjury in her whole story.
examples.text_zh: 在她的整个陈述中，我们没看到任何伪证。

examples.text_en: The new job can come with many good perks for us.
examples.text_zh: 这份新工作能给我们带来许多不错的额外福利。

examples.text_en: Good perks are a big part of this great job.
examples.text_zh: 优厚的福利是这份好工作的重要部分。

examples.text_en: She felt perky after a good night of sleep.
examples.text_zh: 睡了一夜好觉后，她精神抖擞。

examples.text_en: The perky child was full of fun all morning.
examples.text_zh: 那个活泼的孩子整个上午都充满了欢乐。

examples.text_en: They want some permanence in their family life.
examples.text_zh: 他们希望在家庭生活中有一点恒久的东西。

examples.text_en: The permanence of this change is not yet clear.
examples.text_zh: 这一变化能否持久尚不清楚。

examples.text_en: This ground is permeable and will let water through.
examples.text_zh: 这地面有渗透性，水能透过去。

examples.text_en: The old wall was not permeable at all.
examples.text_zh: 这堵旧墙完全不透水。

examples.text_en: It is not permissible to leave the room now.
examples.text_zh: 现在离开这个房间是不允许的。

examples.text_en: Such a change is permissible under the new rules.
examples.text_zh: 在新规定下，这样的改动是允许的。

examples.text_en: The school is quite permissive about play and music.
examples.text_zh: 这所学校对玩耍和音乐相当宽容。

examples.text_en: His permissive way with the children was well known.
examples.text_zh: 他对孩子放任的做法是出了名的。

examples.text_en: That was a pernicious idea for the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 对整个小组来说，那是个有害的想法。

examples.text_en: Bad news can have a pernicious power over people.
examples.text_zh: 坏消息会给人带来恶劣的影响。

examples.text_en: This line is perpendicular to the other one.
examples.text_zh: 这条线与另一条线垂直。

examples.text_en: They stand perpendicular to the wall for a while.
examples.text_zh: 他们贴着墙站得笔直，站了一会儿。

examples.text_en: The whole thing was perplexing to everyone in the room.
examples.text_zh: 对房间里的每个人来说，整件事都令人费解。

examples.text_en: It was a perplexing problem with no easy answer.
examples.text_zh: 那是个没有简单答案的难题。

examples.text_en: His face can show deep perplexity about the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 他的表情流露出对新计划的深深困惑。

examples.text_en: There was real perplexity in the whole group then.
examples.text_zh: 当时整个小组都充满了困惑。

examples.text_en: A car is a perquisite of this top job.
examples.text_zh: 配车是这份高层工作的特殊待遇。

examples.text_en: The perquisite can come with the office he has.
examples.text_zh: 这份额外待遇可以伴随他所担任的职务而来。

examples.text_en: They should not persecute people for their own words.
examples.text_zh: 他们不该因为别人说的话就去迫害他们。

examples.text_en: The group was persecuted for a very long time.
examples.text_zh: 这个群体曾长期受到迫害。

examples.text_en: She will persevere until the whole work is done.
examples.text_zh: 她会坚持到整项工作完成为止。

examples.text_en: We must persevere even when things go wrong.
examples.text_zh: 即使事情不顺利，我们也必须坚持不懈。

examples.text_en: Their light persiflage was fun for the whole room.
examples.text_zh: 他们轻松的玩笑让满屋子人都很开心。

examples.text_en: He used persiflage to answer a serious question.
examples.text_zh: 他用插科打诨来回答一个严肃的问题。

examples.text_en: Her persistence can help her win the whole game.
examples.text_zh: 她的坚持能帮她赢得整场比赛。

examples.text_en: The persistence of this problem is a real pain.
examples.text_zh: 这个问题持续存在，真让人头疼。

examples.text_en: The persnickety man found a problem with every small thing.
examples.text_zh: 那个爱挑剔的男人对每一件小事都能挑出毛病。

examples.text_en: She is persnickety about the look of her room.
examples.text_zh: 她对自己房间的样子非常挑剔。

examples.text_en: He is a personable man with a good voice.
examples.text_zh: 他风度很好，嗓音也不错。

examples.text_en: Her personable way can make a meeting a great success.
examples.text_zh: 她讨人喜欢的作风能让一次会议大获成功。

examples.text_en: A great personage was at the school that day.
examples.text_zh: 那天学校来了一位大人物。

examples.text_en: The book has a personage we all love.
examples.text_zh: 这本书里有一个我们都很喜欢的人物。

examples.text_en: She is the personification of hard work and care.
examples.text_zh: 她是勤奋与关怀的化身。

examples.text_en: The personification of the air was fun for children.
examples.text_zh: 把空气拟人化，让孩子们觉得很有趣。

examples.text_en: The company will need more personnel for this project.
examples.text_zh: 公司这个项目将需要更多人员。

examples.text_en: All the medical personnel were at the front that day.
examples.text_zh: 那天所有医务人员都在前线。

examples.text_en: This work can give me a new perspective on the world.
examples.text_zh: 这项工作能让我对世界有新的看法。

examples.text_en: From this perspective the whole problem can look different.
examples.text_zh: 从这个角度看，整个问题会显得不一样。

examples.text_en: She was perspicacious about the real reason for it.
examples.text_zh: 她对这件事的真正原因看得很透彻。

examples.text_en: His perspicacious mind saw through the whole plan.
examples.text_zh: 他敏锐的头脑看穿了整个计划。

examples.text_en: The perspicuity of her writing can help us all.
examples.text_zh: 她文笔明晰，能帮到我们所有人。

examples.text_en: The perspicuity of his words was clear to us.
examples.text_zh: 他话语的明晰我们都能感受到。

examples.text_en: Her perspicuous answer was easy to follow.
examples.text_zh: 她明白清楚的回答很容易理解。

examples.text_en: This book can give a perspicuous account of the event.
examples.text_zh: 这本书能清楚地叙述整个事件。

examples.text_en: The hard work left him full of perspiration.
examples.text_zh: 繁重的劳动让他浑身是汗。

examples.text_en: There was perspiration on his face after the race.
examples.text_zh: 跑完比赛后，他脸上全是汗。

examples.text_en: People perspire more when the day is hot.
examples.text_zh: 天热的时候，人出汗更多。

examples.text_en: He will perspire during the long hard game.
examples.text_zh: 在这场漫长而艰苦的比赛中他会出汗。

examples.text_en: We need a lot of persuasion to change his mind.
examples.text_zh: 我们需要费很多口舌才能让他改变主意。

examples.text_en: Her power of persuasion was a great help to us.
examples.text_zh: 她的说服力对我们帮助很大。

examples.text_en: His persuasive words can help the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 他有说服力的话能帮到整个小组。

examples.text_en: Her talk about the new plan was very persuasive.
examples.text_zh: 她关于新计划的讲话很有说服力。

examples.text_en: These rules pertain to the whole school, not just us.
examples.text_zh: 这些规定适用于全校，不只是我们。

examples.text_en: The questions seem to pertain to the main problem.
examples.text_zh: 这些问题似乎与主要问题有关。

examples.text_en: He was pertinacious about the plan and would not stop.
examples.text_zh: 他对这个计划非常执着，不肯罢休。

examples.text_en: Her pertinacious work can help the team win at last.
examples.text_zh: 她顽强的努力能帮助队伍最终获胜。

examples.text_en: She had a pertinent question about the whole plan.
examples.text_zh: 她提出了一个与整个计划相关的问题。

examples.text_en: His words were pertinent to the matter at hand.
examples.text_zh: 他的话与当前的事情密切相关。

examples.text_en: The bad news did perturb the whole family.
examples.text_zh: 这个坏消息确实扰乱了一家人的心绪。

examples.text_en: Please do not perturb him while he is working.
examples.text_zh: 他在工作的时候，请不要打扰他。

examples.text_en: We like to peruse the old books in the room.
examples.text_zh: 我们喜欢在房间里仔细翻阅那些旧书。

examples.text_en: He will peruse the report before the meeting today.
examples.text_zh: 他会在今天开会前仔细阅读这份报告。

examples.text_en: A sense of hope can pervade the whole town.
examples.text_zh: 一种希望的感觉会弥漫整个小镇。

examples.text_en: Music will pervade the street during the great event.
examples.text_zh: 在大活动期间，音乐将弥漫整条街道。

examples.text_en: The new style of music is pervasive in this city.
examples.text_zh: 这种新的音乐风格在这座城市里很流行。

examples.text_en: There was a pervasive sense of hope in the group.
examples.text_zh: 小组里弥漫着一种希望的感觉。

examples.text_en: He had a perverse love to cause problems for us.
examples.text_zh: 他有一种反常的爱好，喜欢给我们制造麻烦。

examples.text_en: It was a perverse thing to say to a kind man.
examples.text_zh: 对一位善良的人说这种话，实在有悖常情。

examples.text_en: A bad friend can pervert a young man over time.
examples.text_zh: 一个坏朋友会慢慢带坏一个年轻人。

examples.text_en: They try to pervert the truth to save themselves.
examples.text_zh: 他们试图歪曲真相来保全自己。

examples.text_en: This ground is pervious and will let water in.
examples.text_zh: 这地面能渗水，会让水渗进去。

examples.text_en: Her mind was pervious to the new thought of other people.
examples.text_zh: 她的头脑能接受别人新的想法。

examples.text_en: That pesky thing would not leave the whole room.
examples.text_zh: 那个讨厌的东西在整个房间里赶都赶不走。

examples.text_en: We had a pesky problem with the phone today.
examples.text_zh: 我们今天的电话出了个棘手的问题。

examples.text_en: There is too much pessimism in the group today.
examples.text_zh: 今天小组里悲观情绪太浓了。

examples.text_en: His pessimism about the future was hard for us.
examples.text_zh: 他对未来的悲观让我们很难受。
